program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c bg)) (grid-colors g)))
                  (counts (map (lambda (c) (list c (length (find-color g c)))) colors))
                  (sorted-counts (sort-by counts (lambda (p) (nth p 1))))
                  (marker-color (nth (first sorted-counts) 0))
                  (block-color (nth (last sorted-counts) 0))
                  (objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) block-color))
                                (objects g bg)))
                  (odd-count (count-where (lambda (o)
                                            (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                                                   (h (+ 1 (- (nth bb 2) (nth bb 0))))
                                                   (w (+ 1 (- (nth bb 3) (nth bb 1)))))
                                              (and (= (mod h 2) 1) (= (mod w 2) 1))))
                                          objs))
                  (even-count (- (length objs) odd-count))
                  (keep-cross (> odd-count even-count))
                  (g2 (if keep-cross g (recolor g marker-color bg)))
                  (result (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                                    (with-bbox obj
                                               (r1 c1 r2 c2)
                                               (let* ((h (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                                                      (w (+ 1 (- c2 c1))))
                                                 (if (and
                                                       (= (mod h 2) 1)
                                                       (= (mod w 2) 1))
                                                     (set-cell acc
                                                               (+ r1 (/ (- r2 r1) 2))
                                                               (+ c1 (/ (- c2 c1) 2))
                                                               marker-color)
                                                     acc))))
                                  g2
                                  objs)))
             result))))
